duration.text: The Artistic Design at Chongqing University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Certificate of HSK HSK 3 for Science & Engineering Degree Programs Applicants. HSK 6 for Liberal Arts Programs Applicants.

requirements.text: 1.Be in good Health 2.Non-Chinese citizen 3.Aged 18-40 4.High school diploma holder or above
